an6.28:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
an6.28:1.2: atha kho tesaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāle sannipatitānaṃ sannisinnānaṃ ayamantarā kathā udapādi:
an6.28:1.3: “ko nu kho āvuso samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti”
an6.28:2.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu te bhikkhu etadavoca:
an6.28:2.2: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto pāde pakkhāletvā nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā, so samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.
an6.28:3.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
an6.28:3.2: na kho āvuso so samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:3.3: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto pāde pakkhāletvā nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā, cārittakilamathopissa tasmiṃ samaye appaṭippassaddho hoti, bhattakilamathopissa tasmiṃ samaye appaṭippassaddho hoti.
an6.28:3.4: tasmā na kho so asamayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:3.5: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito vihārapacchāyāyaṃ nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā, so samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.
an6.28:4.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
an6.28:4.2: na kho āvuso so samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:4.3: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito vihārapacchāyāyaṃ nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ abhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā, yadevassa divā samādhi nimittaṃ manasikataṃ hoti, tadevassa tasmiṃ samaye samudācarati.
an6.28:4.4: tasmā na kho so samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:4.5: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā, so samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.
an6.28:5.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
an6.28:5.2: na kho āvuso so samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:5.3: yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā, ojaṭṭhāyissa tasmiṃ samaye kāyeṃ hoti. phāsussa hoti buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasikātuṃ.
an6.28:5.4: tasmā so samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.
an6.28:6.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā mahākaccāno there bhikkhū etadavoca:
an6.28:6.2: “sammukhā metaṃ āvuso bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ-”
an6.28:6.3: ”chayime bhikkhū, samayā manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:7.2: idha bhikkhu, yasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. tasmiṃ samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo:
an6.28:7.3: ahaṃ kho āvuso kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharāmi kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāmi.
an6.28:7.4: sādhu vata me āyasmā kāmarāgassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desetūti.
an6.28:7.5: tassa manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu kāmarāgassa pahānāya dhammaṃ deseti.
an6.28:7.6: ayaṃ bhikkhu, paṭhamo samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ. (2)
an6.28:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhu, yasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu vyāpādapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati …pe… (3)
an6.28:12.1: yaṃ nimittaṃ āgamma yaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, taṃ nimittaṃ na jānāti, na passati. tasmiṃ samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo:
an6.28:12.2: ahaṃ kho āvuso yaṃ nimittaṃ āgamma yaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, taṃ nimittaṃ na jānāmi, na passāmi.
an6.28:12.3: sādhu vata me āyasmā āsavānaṃ khayāya dhammaṃ desetūti.
an6.28:12.4: tassa manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayāya dhammaṃ deseti.
an6.28:12.5: ayaṃ bhikkhu chaṭṭho samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:13.1: sammukhā metaṃ āvuso bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:
an6.28:13.2: ime kho bhikkhu, cha samayā manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.
